event: FOMC minutes today, Wed 18 Nov, at 21:00 SAST. US housing starts also today (time UNVERIFIED, usually 15:30 SAST).

bullets.title: Below 3,800
bullets.text: Gold is about 3,790-3,794, down roughly 1.4% on the day and under 3,800 for the first time in over a year (quote time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: More support broke
bullets.text: The 3,815-3,835 zone that caught the Asian dip has given way, so it now acts as resistance on any bounce.

bullets.title: Hike nearly priced
bullets.text: December quarter-point hike odds are about 94-96% across sources, which keeps pressure on gold.

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index is about 103.6 near its highs, while the 10-year yield eased slightly to about 5.09-5.10%.

bullets.title: Gulf tension
bullets.text: Strikes around Bahrain and Qeshm Island and a near halt in Hormuz shipping lift oil, which feeds hike fears more than safe-haven buying.

bullets.title: Minutes tonight
bullets.text: The October FOMC minutes at 21:00 SAST can move gold fast in either direction.

levels.note: Mitrade support zone, broken this morning

buy.title: Buy plan: hold at 3,750-3,770 (counter-trend)
look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down, so use half size or skip it.
Price dipping into 3,750-3,770 and holding, not slicing through.
A 15M close back above 3,770 after the dip.
The dollar easing from 103.6 and yields slipping under 5.08%.
Take some profit at 3,780 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying a falling price before it shows a hold. Wait for the 15M close above 3,770.
A 1H close under 3,742 can run toward 3,730, then 3,680-3,700.
Hawkish FOMC minutes at 21:00 SAST or Gulf headlines can break support fast. Avoid entering in the 15 minutes before the minutes.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection at 3,800-3,835
look: Price bouncing back up into 3,800-3,835 and stalling there.
A clear 15M rejection wick or bearish close back under 3,800.
The dollar firm near 103.6 and yields near 5.1%.
Take some profit at 3,780 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling at 3,790 after a 1.4% drop. That is chasing; wait for a bounce to 3,800-3,835.
FOMC minutes at 21:00 SAST can cause a sharp spike either way. Avoid entering in the 15 minutes before.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
